label: VRM humanoid (0.x / 1.0)
notes: Keys are our canonical (KayKit) bones, values are VRM humanoid bone names (same names in VRM 0.x and 1.0). The VRM file's own humanoid table (extensions.VRM / VRMC_vrm) says which node is which, so no name guessing is needed. Our 'chest' is the top of the spine: upperChest when the avatar has one.
